name: C068 Kẻ Ban Phước (Quyền Trượng Tinh Tú Ban Phước)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Astral Blesser's starlight armillary scepter (Quyền Trượng Tinh Tú Ban Phước - C068 Kẻ Ban Phước) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete celestial scepter staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (ivory-and-gold fluted shaft) to top-right (interlocking golden armillary sphere rings surrounding a radiant eight-pointed cyan-and-gold star crystal).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top armillary star crest with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use burnished celestial gold, midnight-blue enamel, silver, and bright cyan-gold starlight).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Astral Armillary Starlight Staff (Quyền Trượng Tinh Tú Ban Phước - C068 Kẻ Ban Phước) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the golden armillary star scepter diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a high observatory sanctuary under a starry cosmos where golden-cyan constellations and blessing halos orbit the staff.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
